name: Apple Inc.
description: Apple designs, manufactures, and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables, and accessories. The company also sells a range of related services.

name: Alphabet Inc.
description: Alphabet is a holding company that engages in the acquisition and operation of different companies. Its segments include Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets.

name: Tesla Inc.
description: Tesla designs, develops, manufactures, leases, and sells electric vehicles, and energy generation and storage systems in the United States and internationally.

name: Amazon.com Inc.
description: Amazon engages in retail sale of consumer products, advertising, and subscription services through online and physical stores across the world.

name: Microsoft Corp.
description: Microsoft develops and supports software, services, devices, and solutions worldwide across Productivity, Intelligent Cloud, and Personal Computing segments.

name: NVIDIA Corp.
description: NVIDIA provides graphics, computing, and networking solutions worldwide. The company operates through Compute & Networking and Graphics segments.

name: Meta Platforms Inc.
description: Meta builds technologies that help people connect and share. The company operates through Family of Apps and Reality Labs segments.

name: Netflix Inc.
description: Netflix provides entertainment services, offering TV series, documentaries, feature films, and games across various genres and languages worldwide.

name: Advanced Micro Devices
description: AMD operates as a semiconductor company providing x86 microprocessors, GPUs, and field-programmable gate arrays for data center and embedded markets.

name: Intel Corp.
description: Intel designs, manufactures, and sells computing and related products and services worldwide. The company delivers integrated circuit design and manufacturing.

name: Salesforce Inc.
description: Salesforce provides customer relationship management technology that brings companies and customers together across sales, service, marketing, and commerce.

name: Oracle Corp.
description: Oracle provides products and services that address enterprise information technology environments, including cloud and license business and hardware products.

name: Adobe Inc.
description: Adobe operates as a diversified software company providing content creation, document management, and digital marketing solutions worldwide.

name: PayPal Holdings
description: PayPal operates as a technology platform that enables digital payments on behalf of merchants and consumers worldwide.

name: Block Inc.
description: Block provides financial services and mobile payment solutions including Square for sellers and Cash App for individuals.

name: Shopify Inc.
description: Shopify provides a commerce platform and services for businesses of all sizes, enabling them to sell products online, in retail stores, and through social channels.

name: Uber Technologies
description: Uber develops and operates proprietary technology applications providing ride-hailing, food delivery, and freight brokerage services worldwide.

name: Lyft Inc.
description: Lyft operates a peer-to-peer marketplace for on-demand ridesharing in the United States and select cities in Canada.

name: Snap Inc.
description: Snap operates as a technology company focusing on camera and social media through Snapchat, Spectacles, and various advertising products.

name: Pinterest Inc.
description: Pinterest operates as a visual discovery engine allowing users to find inspiration for various activities including recipes, travel, and style.

name: Roku Inc.
description: Roku operates a TV streaming platform connecting users to streaming content, providing operating systems for smart TVs and streaming devices.

name: Zoom Video Comms.
description: Zoom provides a unified communications platform that enables video, voice, chat, and content sharing through its cloud-native technology.

name: DocuSign Inc.
description: DocuSign provides electronic signature technology and agreement cloud for businesses to manage the process of creating and managing agreements digitally.

name: Coinbase Global
description: Coinbase operates as a financial technology company providing end-to-end financial infrastructure and technology for the crypto-economy.

name: Palantir Technologies
description: Palantir builds and deploys software platforms for the intelligence community and commercial enterprises to assist in counter-terrorism and data-driven decision making.
